checks.name: reused-files-byte-identical
command: set -euo pipefail; src="$HOME/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/Source"; for f in DSP/PitchShifter.h DSP/PitchShifter.cpp DSP/DelayLineFrac.h DSP/DelayLineFrac.cpp DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.h DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.cpp DSP/WidthProcessor.h DSP/WidthProcessor.cpp GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp GUI/RotarySlider.h GUI/RotarySlider.cpp GUI/GoniometerComponent.h GUI/GoniometerComponent.cpp GUI/CorrelationMeter.h GUI/CorrelationMeter.cpp; do cmp -s "$src/$f" "Source/$f"; done

checks.name: parameter-ids-present
command: set -euo pipefail; test -f Source/ParameterIDs.h; for id in voiceCount timingSpread pitchSpread humanRate tightness monoXover mix panV1 panV2 panV3 panV4 width latencyMode outTrim bypass masterSeed parameterLayoutVersion; do grep -q "$id" Source/ParameterIDs.h; done

checks.name: scaffold-files-exist
command: set -euo pipefail; for f in CMakeLists.txt CMakePresets.json scripts/build_all.sh .gitignore README.md .gitmodules Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp Source/PluginEditor.h Source/PluginEditor.cpp Source/StateManager.h Source/StateManager.cpp; do test -f "$f"; done; test -x scripts/build_all.sh

checks.name: cmake-configure-only
command: set -euo pipefail; find_cmake(){ if command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v cmake; return; fi; shopt -s nullglob; cands=("$HOME"/.local/share/JetBrains/Toolbox/apps/clion/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake "$HOME"/.local/share/JetBrains/Toolbox/apps/clion/*/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake /opt/clion/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake /snap/clion/current/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake); shopt -u nullglob; for c in "${cands[@]}"; do if [[ -x "$c" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$c"; return; fi; done; return 1; }; CMAKE_BIN="$(find_cmake)"; "$CMAKE_BIN" -S . -B build/phase-a-configure -DSHREDWIDTH_CONFIGURE_ONLY=ON
